name: V143 final predeclared multi-family rhythm-sustain sweep
purpose: Run one final training-only sweep across a frozen menu of distinct spectro-temporal feature families, then stop rhythm/sustain feature engineering and move to the AI-tab pipeline regardless of outcome.
designBasis: all challenger features are deterministic transforms of the frozen spectro-temporal source columns
no V136D, V137, V138, V139, V140, V141, or V142 held-out outcome rows are permitted during development
family selection is performed only from replicated inner-CV evidence on each carrier's outer-training partition
the winning family must independently pass the same strict replicated zero-loss rule in both validation views
after V143 there will be no V144 rhythm/sustain feature sweep; the champion is locked and work moves to the AI-tab pipeline

normalized_temporal_contrast.description: Stabilized normalized first differences between consecutive temporal stages within each band.

adjacent_band_balance.description: Adjacent-band differences at each frozen temporal stage.

spectral_shape.description: Absolute-energy spectral centroid and spread across the five bands at each temporal stage.

attack_sustain_summary.description: Per-band attack mean, sustain mean, and stabilized normalized sustain-minus-attack contrast.

temporal_extrema.description: Per-band temporal range, temporal standard deviation, and stabilized endpoint contrast.
